en:
Angie...
You have an interesting name.

Huh? Really?
Is my name so strange?

No, not "strange" really...
Are you not from here?

Angie lives with Atua on a divine island
paradise.

Ah, right, but...
Where is the island? What's it like?

It's a tiny, divine island.
It used to be much bigger...

But Atua used a natural disaster to make it
smaller cuz He thought it would look cuter.
<CLT=cltMIND>*That* was the reason?

My island has lots of plants and flowers
too, y'know?
Ah, is that so?

But most of the plants and flowers on my
island like to attack people.
They attack people!?

Come to think of it...I'm honestly not sure
if they're actual plants or flowers.

What...?
What kind of island *is* this?

What do you think, Shuichi? What kinda
place does my island sound like to you?

<CLT=cltMIND>She answered my question
with a question.

If you get it right, Atua will bless you.
I wish you divine luck!
A tropical island paradise?
God's bathhouse?
A castle in the sky?
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>She hasn't given me any useful
hints, so I just have to guess...
A tropical island paradise?

I see, I see...
A tropical island paradise, huh?

I sorta remember a place like that...
Jabba-something Island, I think?
<CLT=cltMIND>Jabba...what?

Atua has spoken... He's not satisfied with
that answer. No blessing for you.
Ah...I see...
God's bathhouse?

Look out! You'll be spirited away!
Nyahahaha! How divine!

Ah, yes. In my hometown, we wash ourselves
in co-ed bathhouses.

Co-ed baths are more relaxing to me.
Let's go in together, Shuichi.

N-No thank you!
I haven't done anything like that before!
A castle in the sky?

Yeah, but it got destroyed.
Atua prefers the ground anyway.
Does Atua live on Earth?

Huh? Don'tcha know, Shuichi?
Atua lives on the ground, y'know?

How's He supposed to stand if He's not
on the ground?
True...
So, where is your hometown, Angie?

In the middle of the ocean! Surrounded by
water and nothing else.

<CLT=cltMIND>A solitary island somewhere
far out to sea...
But I get DeepSea deliveries all the time.
Deep sea? As in...submarines...?

DeepSea is a shipping website. They have
all kinds of stuff. It's super convenient!
Ah, that's what you meant.

I dunno whatcha thought I meant, but I use
DeepSea all the time.

I bet DeepSea is an instrument of Atua, cuz
it made life on my island a divine experience.
Atua works in mysterious ways, I suppose...

DeepSea is how I got new issues of my
favorite magazines...
And food, clothing, organ meat...
Plus medicine, blood, and even children!

W-Wait...are you serious? Some of that
stuff is a little...crazy...

Hm? How so? If it can be shipped, then
DeepSea definitely stocks it.

Now if they just stocked offerings and
OOPArts, that would be so divine.

<CLT=cltMIND>...What exactly goes on
on Angie's island?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>With only a slightly better understanding
of Angie's island, I returned to my room.
